_comment: CarbonShift solver battery test configuration (Rust nshift binary only).
_phases_comment: Each phase is independently toggled by leaving its content list(s) empty: DP runs only if both batch_sizes AND infeasibility_modes are non-empty; online runs only if online_strategies is non-empty; offline runs only if additional_strategies is non-empty. See tests/battery/multiple_runs.py for phase-aware parameter grids that avoid redundantly re-running phases a given knob doesn't affect.
_input_pattern_comment: Simulation-only request pattern: sinusoidal follows the daylight load wave; flat keeps a nearly constant rate with seeded 5%-of-rate slot-count jitter and the same rounded horizon total. Both retain random sub-slot arrival times. multiple_runs.py sweeps both by default. This does not configure client emulation.
_online_batch_sizes_comment: Batch sizes swept ONLY by online_strategies, independent of the DP phase's batch_sizes above. Omit to fall back to batch_sizes. singleton_best always forces N=1 regardless of this list.
_flavours_comment: Optional override of Config::default()'s 3 built-in Accurate/Balanced/Fast flavours, applied to every phase/scenario in this run. Omit (or rename away the __ suffix below) to keep nshift's built-in defaults (see config.rs).
_runtime_knobs_comment: Runtime knobs below mirror rust/src/config.rs; omit any of them to fall back to that file's Config::default() values. rollback_max_consecutive/max_batch_solver_parallelism affect DP and singleton_best only; online_swarm_mode affects bandit/ant_colony only (see multiple_runs.py sensitivity matrix).
